verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents issuing and distributing physical nominated and innominate cards with horizontal or vertical designs, a card design-and-production process it runs, and batch issuance of innominate cards stored at its logistics partner, so the client does not manage the manufacturer. It also documents tracking card shipments to the delivery address. Missing for 10: explicit API endpoints for ordering physical cards and setting custom art (the design process reads as a guided onboarding flow), selectable shipping methods, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
